sheets.label: 1:500,000 L-42-А Dzhezkazgan
sheets.credit: USSR Ministry of Geology / Kazakh SSR Ministry of Geology; Central Kazakhstan series; native historical author and institutional credits preserved in complete source plates. Aerogeologiya, Moscow 1981 print; catalog series 1978. Via geokniga.org.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 226 sampled native shared-legend references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1981; series/catalog 1978. Black and white native units retained; dark ink is not globally inpainted. No independent water mask: blue/white geological colors are not discarded, and hydrography is not independently interpreted. Scan and Colors remain source-derived approximations, not modern geological coverage or field-grade interpretation.
sheets.accuracy: 8 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 3.79px, leave-one-out max 24.92px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
